claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost { kind: 'short_rest' }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Arcane Recovery is activated at the end of a Short Rest, not as a turn-action or bonus action. The current ClassFeatureActivationCost only supports 'free' (free on owner's turn) and 'bonus_action'. A rest-triggered activation variant is needed to represent features whose window of use is tied to finishing a rest, not consuming turn-economy quota.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect { kind: 'recover_spell_slots', maxTotalLevel: LinearPerLevel<number>, maxSlotLevel: number }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is recovering expended spell slots subject to two simultaneous constraints: a combined-level cap that scales with class level (ceil(wizardLevel/2)), and a per-slot level cap (max slot level 5). No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant (grant_extra_action, heal_hp) covers spell slot recovery. The v4 taxonomy 'refund' procedure atom anticipates the concept but is not surfaced as a ClassFeatureEffect variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than half your Wizard level (round up), and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher.
